message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are performed on any incoming data; files are read and tensors constructed without validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: All data is read from local directories; no remote sources are accessed, and no checksum or integrity verification is present anywhere in the code.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is performed on the training data at any point in the pipeline.

No detected model integrity verification: Models are loaded via torch.load() in both inference.py and test.py without any hash check, signature verification, pinned revision, or controlled-source validation.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop performs standard forward/backward passes with no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly checks.
No detected differential privacy: The optimizer is a plain Adam with no differential privacy wrappers such as Opacus or DP-SGD applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: The test set is loaded from a hardcoded pickle file with no integrity checks (hashing/signing), and although a separate test split appears to be used via get_data_loaders, there is no isolation enforcement or multiple independent metric sources to guard against manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The inference function directly reads files from disk and passes them to the model without any shape, range, type, or schema validation on the extracted audio features.
No detected output bounds checks: The inference code calls argmax directly on model outputs without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation before printing results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an audio classification model (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
